name: NeoGoat December 2026
source: Maintainer's final December 2026 list, including subsequent additions through Amphibious Bugroth MK-11 and Blizzard Dragon on November 12, 2026

base.hashEncoding: UTF-8 with LF line endings (the Git blob); normalize CRLF only when checking a Windows checkout

notes: Final December 2026 list supplied by the maintainer on November 11; rebuilt from the frozen October pool and superseding all earlier December drafts. October remains the active format.
Removed cards are absent from the December pool, not retained with forbidden status.
All retained October card metadata is inherited unchanged; only copy limits listed in statusChanges are adjusted.
Ninja Grandmaster Hanzo and Soul Servant enter the Extra Card Pool semi-limited (two copies each); the other eleven additions enter unlimited (three copies each).
New card identities and stats were checked against YGOPRODeck; English texts follow the official TCG database links above. These metadata do not establish NeoGoat engine rulings or an errata policy.
November 11: Chaos Distill joins the final Extra Card Pool unlimited (three copies).
November 11: Koa'ki Meiru Gravirose joins the final Extra Card Pool unlimited (three copies).
November 12: Elemental HERO Nova Master is restored to the final Extra Card Pool limited (one copy), retaining its October entry unchanged.

November 12: Amphibious Bugroth MK-11 joins the Extra Card Pool unlimited (three copies). Identity comes from the existing EDOPro card database; English text and stats were checked against the official TCG database.
November 12: Blizzard Dragon joins the Extra Card Pool unlimited (three copies). Identity and text use the existing card database, checked against the official TCG database.

additions.name: Ninja Grandmaster Hanzo
additions.text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Ninjitsu Art" card from your Deck to your hand. When this card is Flip or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Ninja" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Ninja Grandmaster Hanzo".

additions.name: Soul Servant
additions.text: Place 1 card on top of the Deck from your hand, Deck, or GY, that is "Dark Magician" or mentions "Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl", except "Soul Servant". During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; draw cards equal to the number of "Palladium" monsters, "Dark Magician", and/or "Dark Magician Girl", with different names, on the field and in the GYs. You can only use this effect of "Soul Servant" once per turn.

additions.name: Surface
additions.text: Target 1 Level 3 or lower Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua monster in your GY; Special Summon it in Defense Position.

additions.name: Dweller in the Depths
additions.text: Gains 300 ATK for each Continuous Spell in your Spell & Trap Zone.

additions.name: Valhalla, Hall of the Fallen
additions.text: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Fairy monster from your hand. You must control no monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

additions.name: Mei-Kou, Master of Barriers
additions.text: You can Tribute this card, then target 1 face-up Continuous Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

additions.name: Elemental HERO Escuridao
additions.text:
1 "Elemental HERO" monster + 1 DARK monster
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 100 ATK for each "Elemental HERO" monster in your GY.

additions.name: Rage of the Deep Sea
additions.text: This card gains 500 ATK and DEF for each Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster in your Graveyard.

additions.name: Fish Depth Charge
additions.text: Tribute 1 Fish monster, then target 1 card on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, draw 1 card.

additions.name: Chaos Distill
additions.text:
While this card is face-up on the field, any card sent to your GY is banished instead. You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Add 1 "Macro Cosmos", or 1 card that mentions it, from your Deck to your hand, except "Chaos Distill".
● If "Macro Cosmos" is on the field: Banish this face-up card from the Spell & Trap Zone; add 1 LIGHT monster with ? ATK from your Deck to your hand.
You can only use this effect of "Chaos Distill" once per turn.

additions.name: Koa'ki Meiru Gravirose
additions.text: During each of your End Phases, destroy this card unless you send 1 "Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru" from your hand to the Graveyard or reveal 1 Plant-Type monster in you hand. During each of your Standby Phases, you can send 1 Level 3 or lower monster from your Deck to your Graveyard.

additions.name: Amphibious Bugroth MK-11
additions.text: While "Umi" is not on the field, this card gains 700 ATK, also it cannot attack directly. While "Umi" is on the field: You can target 1 face-up non-WATER monster on the field; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Amphibious Bugroth MK-11" once per turn.

additions.name: Blizzard Dragon
additions.text: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; it cannot change its battle position or declare an attack until the end of your opponent's next turn.
